citations.case: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, code first note at M36.2 (code first underlying disease, such as classical hemophilia, D66); ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.13 (etiology/manifestation convention: the underlying condition is sequenced first, followed by the manifestation) and Section I.B.7 (where a code first note exists and an underlying condition is present, the underlying condition is sequenced first); Section I.B.5 (signs and symptoms associated routinely with a disease process are not assigned as additional codes)

coder_notes: The provider lists hemophilic arthropathy of the right knee first and hemophilia A second, and states the arthropathy is due to the hemophilia. The arthropathy code carries a code first note for the underlying disease, so the hemophilia code is sequenced first; the order in which the provider lists the diagnoses does not change that. Hemophilia A is hereditary factor VIII deficiency. The arthropathy code has no site or laterality, so the right knee is not coded. There is no bleeding into the joint at this visit; the earlier bleeds are history. The joint changes are attributed to the hemophilia, so no osteoarthritis code is used. Knee pain and stiffness are symptoms of the arthropathy. Traps: listing the arthropathy code first, as the note does; leaving off the hemophilia code; an osteoarthritis code for the right knee (M17.11); a hemarthrosis code; a knee pain code
